notes.title: New levels and challenges
notes.content:
[p]We’ve added a new and easiest entry level to the game – [b]Beginner[/b].

To release a full-fledged product, you need [i]energy[/i]. The more energy columns are active, the higher you can sell the finished item. However, be careful: during a [i]Shahed attack[/i], the only way to preserve an energy column is to [i]switch it off[/i]. Preferably just [i]for a while[/i] — after all, you want to keep [i]earning money[/i]![/p][previewyoutube="SFRXB08AwSg;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Warning: Shahed drones!
notes.content: [p]In the next version: be ready to control the [i]power columns[/i]. [b]Shut one down[/b] before a Shahed hits it to keep it safe[/p][previewyoutube="TckG4lkVvow;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: New energy management tools
notes.content:
[p]Despite the automation of processes, having [i]manual control[/i] is always nice. The upcoming version will feature an [i]improved energy strategy[/i] for the conveyor. You will have full control over the [b]energy columns[/b], enabling you to turn them on or off at will. This will directly impact resource consumption: you may choose to optimize energy usage to save costs. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464812/d38075829ff83ae2c50986d840af39bf97636998.jpg"][/img]
And one more thing: did you know that during [i]attacks on [b]the energy system[/b][/i], it's better to have it [b]turned off[/b]?.. [/p]

notes.title: Bug fixed
notes.content: [p]Our advice remains the same: buy Blaster gun! ːsteammockingː[/p]

notes.title: Small improvements
notes.content:
[p]You can now see how much you [i]earn[/i] from producing a single ware, depending on the [i]difficulty level[/i] (conveyor speed).[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464812/688d082698b7ea4bb8c2882d7151a417421e226d.png"][/img][/p][p]You'll also know exactly how much you've [i]earned[/i], and how much those cheeky drones have [i]stolen[/i]. Time to buy a [b]Blaster gun[/b]![/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464812/322686b618bd4dfa4520a2aa026a42ac5a9207cc.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Working hard. Protecting always
notes.content:
[p]The new version includes a range of convenient and interesting updates.[/p][p]
After [b]building[/b] your conveyor, take a moment to [b]look around[/b] and study its layout.[/p][list][*][p]start the conveyor using the [b]dedicated button[/b] on the [b]starting cell[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464812/33e9051851804666eba8192e4f6f84ac5dbc9f69.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]browse the [b]available equipment[/b] on a separate settings page[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464812/133196312353c89f21c36b4e4042cab244e64003.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]buy new equipment in the [b]shop[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464812/2141188309dd1f3b225e96e30db0863f03afcaf8.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]use [b]blaster guns[/b] to protect your conveyor from [b]drones[/b] that steal your products[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464812/4e1fd6e5dfe3428868c819a91d746d49e893c163.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Gather funds ːsteamthisː to fully [b]automate your production[/b] with equipment arriving soon in the shop! ːsteamthumbsupː[/p]

notes.title: New equipment to protect your factory: coming soon!
notes.content: [p]In today’s world, [i]drones[/i] are everywhere — and not always for peaceful purposes. Around here, they’re trying to steal your goods right off the conveyor belt, cutting into your profits. But don’t worry — there’s a way to fight back, and it’s highly effective.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464812/d463266af863c5b0bd213af0f48adefea66b4b7b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Use the [b]Blaster Gun[/b] — or better yet, use two![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464812/203ab1045de450bed0192138c5ca72898567645c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][url="https://www.facebook.com/share/v/192K6HoHt8/"]https://www.facebook.com/share/v/192K6HoHt8/[/url][/p]

notes.title: Introducing a new character!
notes.content:
In the modern world, [b]drones[/b] serve many roles — and soon, you’ll have to face them too. Will you need special [b]tools[/b] or skills to succeed? That remains to be seen…

https://www.facebook.com/share/v/199CRgzNGx/

notes.title: Work and earn
notes.content:
So, from now on, your task becomes more meaningful. The money you earn is [i]deposited[/i] into your account

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464812/9a77cfce99749536a25d49c34638f424a68394ac.jpg[/img]

You can also [i]borrow[/i] money and [i]repay[/i] it to the bank. Don’t forget that borrowed funds are subject to an [i]interest rate[/i] of [b]3%[/b]

[b]Why do you need money?[/b] Haha, funny question! ːsteammockingː But seriously — at the very least, to cover your [i]losses[/i]. The conveyor relies on [i]energy columns[/i] to function. Losing any of them reduces the power supply, forcing you to cut back on workshop [i]lighting[/i] — and working in the dark is no fun!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464812/2a8e6ea87d489b2f61b931050669377cfb8281b9.png[/img]

You can monitor the energy status using the new [i]indicator[/i] on the right. If you lose all your [strike]lives[/strike] [i]energy columns[/i], you'll have to work with [i]daylight[/i] only. And that light — it’s very unpredictable!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464812/937b588fd1437f2358e4971cfde96d49c3386332.png[/img]

But there’s a solution: you can go to the [b]shop[/b] and buy new [i]energy columns[/i] there!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464812/a1d6b5525bed223808f4db0e1fe416c34c8215ed.jpg[/img]

Earn, don’t lose, and upgrade! And this is only the start - more challenges await, and your skill will decide the outcome. The conveyor will keep expanding, so you’ll need new tools to manage it. Head to the shop!

notes.title: Financial management
notes.content:
The conveyor is a great tool for daily training of [i]attention[/i], [i]reaction[/i], and [i]memory[/i]. However, we want to offer you [b]something more[/b]. We are already working on a major update that will turn it into a wonderful little technical [i]world[/i] where you can earn and borrow funds, invest them in purchasing new devices to ease and speed up production.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464812/a8a0ceddf17ed85a3bc7433b4cfb2f7dcda420ce.jpg[/img]

[i]Energy stations[/i], auxiliary [i]equipment[/i], [i]robots[/i], and [i]automatic guiding cells[/i] are just a small part of what will be available. And how about [i]programming some devices[/i] right in the game? Don't know how? You'll learn!

notes.title: Production and competition
notes.content:
Have you already mastered the basic [i]pipeline[/i]? Have you learned to manage it, ensuring stable operation? 

Wonderful! 

It's time to enter the market and accumulate [i]capital[/i]! You will encounter various goals, tasks, devices, and tools that develop the brain and make it work much more efficiently! Very soon, we will start [b]counting[/b], so no success of yours will go unnoticed!

notes.title: Let the Robot help us!
notes.content:
Hooray! ːsteamhappyː

From now on, if a ball heads toward the wrong "[i]finish line[/i]", there's no need to tear your hair out. 

You now have a chance to fix the situation. [b]Click on the final cell[/b] it’s moving toward, and the [i]transport robot[/i] will arrive to protect it from error. It will [i]automatically[/i] move the ball to one of the [i]available boxes[/i] (if any are left) and then become available again to correct your mistakes.  

But remember: the robot will stay on guard [i]until it completes the task[/i]! Only after that it will become available again.

Check out our updates on [url=https://www.facebook.com/share/v/18qLa18KMF/][b]Facebook[/b][/url]:

notes.title: Explosive growth
notes.content:
A [i]small[/i] conveyor is just the beginning of the journey. Your [i]brain[/i] is capable of much more. Progress requires keeping yourself in shape, not slowing down but intensifying your training — the results won’t be long in coming. How many directions can you keep in focus? New challenges and new mechanisms are already on the way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464812/45b9a7cd996392a2d64097db67a666c3b3a046b7.png[/img]

notes.content: A minor graphics optimization has been implemented to save your device's resources

notes.title: Accident in the power system
notes.content:
Made a mistake – lost one of the available conveyor [i]power units[/i]. It will take time to fix everything, but for now, try to save the situation by managing the conveyor under suddenly [i]more difficult conditions[/i]. The repair team is already working!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464812/f03b1fcbd7129605f5eeb3f2fc779ddea587f4a3.png[/img]

notes.title: Mysterious boxes
notes.content:
There are many different [i]objects[/i] in the factory workshop. Some may seem like mere "decorations", but as you master the conveyor, they turn out to be critically important. Get ready to meet your [i]helpers[/i] – the new participants in the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464812/91b4b2f8105f7dbd61c0f4f061aacc1f47af10bb.png[/img]

notes.title: Challenge Enhancer
notes.content:
Here's another challenge for your [i]attentiveness[/i]! The [b]Challenge Enhancer[/b] will add some thrill at any [i]difficulty level[/i]. Keep your eyes peeled, because now not all parts of the conveyor belt are equally visible!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464812/4a11c21083f8eae986ad9b4263cfa5566eed2376.png[/img]

notes.content:
The fewer [i]buttons[/i], the easier it is to control the game! A small interface change will benefit the desktop version and even more so the mobile version

notes.title: The difficulty level selection fixed
notes.content: Fixed a bug that occurred when selecting the [i]difficulty level[/i] in the [i]settings[/i] window.

notes.title: Adjustable difficulty
notes.content:
The conveyor now supports three [i]difficulty levels[/i]: [b]low[/b], [b]medium[/b], and [b]high[/b]. The lowest level is great for starting training comfortably. It is also suitable for young children, helping them quickly develop their attention and memory. However, this is beneficial for everyone — your brain is ready to generate new neurons!
